product.title: Acadia National Park Bass Harbor Lighthouse Private Driving Tour

description.text: Tour Acadia National Park’s quieter western side on a private driving outing that features Bass Harbor Head Light and scenic Mount Desert Island corridors. Your guide handles routing so you can focus on lighthouse photography, coastal overlooks, and park commentary without self-driving narrow roads. Stops include Bass Harbor Head Light, Mount Desert Island. Local commentary and route logistics are handled so you can focus on coastal overlooks, carriage roads, and photography or adventure highlights. Ideal for visitors basing in Bar Harbor who want a guided Acadia National Park experience without coordinating park logistics, trailheads, or carriage roads on their own.
